infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: We need access to your contacts to help you share rides with friends.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to take photos for document and vehicle verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos for document and vehicle verification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Keke Ride uses your location to show your position on the map and find nearby drivers when you book a ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keke Ride needs Always location while you are online as a driver so you can receive trip requests when the app is in the background or your screen is locked. Your location is only shared while you are online or on a trip.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Keke Ride needs Always location while you are online as a driver so you can receive trip requests when the app is in the background.
